scope: SME area prospect research only. Club home grounds are geographic anchors, not athlete residences, eligibility catchments, endorsers or partners.

research_context.note: PR description and scouted roster reviewed for club/competition context only. No individual identities, demo roster matches or category rights are used.

notes: All previous leads and athlete/category-rights matching have been replaced. No named talent or existing sponsorship rights are offered.
Fifteen leads across six areas: Brookvale 3, Perth 2, Wellington 3, Werribee 2, Wayville/Goodwood 2, Croudace Bay/Warners Bay 3.

Wellington prices and SQL budgets use NZD at the same nominal flight amounts, not an AUD currency conversion. NZ availability and tax-invoice compliance remain unverified and require local review. Australian leads use AUD.

Flight 01 is 750 per quarter, annualised to 3000; Flight 02 is 3500 per year; Flight 03 is 12500 per year. No lead is assigned Flight 03 because research supports local-shop or local-operator scope rather than a national commitment.
No wagering, alcohol or tobacco categories. No club endorsement, partnership or permission to use protected visual assets is claimed.
Verification occurred on 2026-11-18 UTC; 2026-11-19 is the queue date. Rough distances are locality estimates, not geocoded measurements.

SQL is a staged research artefact only, never executed. The sponsors schema cannot persist the research-only or do-not-send safeguards. Do not import until a separate approval process can preserve those restrictions. Coordinates remain NULL, and no agreement or athlete linkage is created.
Own business pages provide street addresses. Wellington postcodes are corroborated by supplementary address sources below.
